limitations: Snapshot and edit dates do not establish present operation. No live hours, booking, fees or temporary closure verification.

Individual mapped courts/fields remain separate; a site with several courts is not one venue count. Softball is included under Baseball field. Athletics track excludes jumping/throwing strips even when OSM tags those as leisure=track.
School grounds and paid sports venues may have restricted hours/bookings even when not explicitly mapped private. Known private/no/member/resident/permit-only objects and inactive tags are excluded.

Swimming pools need mapped public access/operator/municipal website, reviewed facility evidence, or containment in a positively identified public aquatic venue. Unknown, private, hotel and residential pools are excluded, as are wading pools/hot tubs/lazy rivers. This conservative rule can omit genuine public pools.

Park/facility/school association uses reference-point containment in mapped polygons, not proximity or ownership. Unnamed courts retain sport labels and mapped site names; no official names or entrance addresses are invented. School/campus context has its own preserved download and object dates.
Distances use source points or feature bounding-box centres, not entrances. SOURCE_BBOX supports spatial matching; it is not a building footprint.

General sports-centre parent rows are removed when the same category has mapped internal pitches. Named aquatic/ice venue rows replace internal pool/rink surfaces. Separate adjacent pitch polygons are preserved.
The rectangle is not an administrative Metro Vancouver boundary. Missing/stale/miscoded features remain possible.
refresh_policy: Two bounded requests (sports and named school/campus context); no retries or runtime visitor queries. Query, dates, partial-response and anomalous-count checks precede atomic output replacement.
